reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's 14 October post in #north-team, which Marcus can see because he's in that channel. I couldn't check it against anything else. The share has no Brackenwater contract or account file, and the North cheat sheet mentions the account but gives no renewal date. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share it with someone on the account's team.
